frame.denominator_type: SBC-adjusted owner FCF per share (OCF - capex - SBC), TTM
frame.gross_source: pack_y5 §4 TTM Q3 FY2026: operating cash flow 7,771 - capex 154 - stock-based compensation (CF line) 1,489 = 6,128 ($M)
frame.alternative_denominator_type: TTM GAAP net income per share (5,238 / 918)
frame.business_type: operating; asset-light subscription software; maturing (decelerating) compounder with AI-disruption risk

helena_floor.floor_type: none (NCAV and tangible book both negative)

break_derivation.mechanism: generative-AI tools commoditize the core creative/document workflows, so paid seats and pricing fall and owner FCF declines in absolute terms while the market re-rates the franchise to a distress multiple.
break_derivation.reference: pack 1.2/3.2/7: Segment 3, one of the three reported segments, shrank in absolute revenue from ~$0.37B (FY2020) to ~$0.19B (FY2025) and took a $50M goodwill impairment in Q2 FY2026 (also: Product 7 standalone 'steeper decline than we expected', Q1 FY2026) -> 1 of 3 named segments broke over FY2020-FY2025 = 33% per 5 years
